content.text: Golf Year Round with PGA TOUR-Quality Standards Play our award-winning golf courses Join Our Eclub Sign up to receive exclusive invitations, special offers, updates and news from TPC Network golf courses across the country! TPC Sawgrass A Membership with Bragging Rights Host Events, Outings and More TPC Sawgrass: Outings & Leisure Groups Details TPC Sawgrass welcomes corporate outings, charity events, and golf groups of all sizes to experience world-class golf on two championship courses – both designed by the legendary, Pete Dye. TPC Sawgrass Dining A Premier Jacksonville Dining Experience About Us Remarkable Golf is Just the Beginning Welcome to golf, service and amenities at the highest level TPC Sawgrass Home of THE PLAYERS Championship Welcome to TPC Sawgrass – Home of THE PLAYERS Championship, birthplace of the TPC Network and backdrop to the PGA TOUR’s Global Home. Located in Ponte Vedra Beach, FL, TPC Sawgrass features two PGA TOUR championship courses designed by world renowned architect, Pete Dye. THE PLAYERS Stadium course sports one of the most recognizable and challenging holes on the PGA TOUR with the Par 3, 17th, and its famous island green. The course was built to challenge TOUR Professionals like no other golf course had done before, while providing an unprecedented experience for spectators. The Dye’s Valley course offers a perfectly balanced golf experience winding through North Florida’s naturally compelling landscape. Opened in 1987, Dye’s Valley has hosted numerous Korn Ferry events and is consistently rated as one of the top courses in Florida.
